title: Beat This! Live - Online Beat and Downbeat Tracking by Predicting the Future
abstract: arXiv:2611.34277v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Beat and downbeat tracking have seen multiple improvements through recent deep learning approaches, but most target an offline setting, precluding their use in real-time scenarios. We adapt a recent offline beat tracking model, Beat This, for online, low-latency operation and propose Beat This! Live, a causal variant designed for real-time beat and downbeat tracking. We present the architectural modifications required to obtain a causal system suitable for streaming inference and measure their impact on accuracy. By training our model with temporally shifted labels, it produces predictions slightly ahead of the current frame, which not only reduces latency, but enables much more effective peak-picking. Evaluation on the GTZAN dataset shows the F1-score improves from 80.6 to 86.7 for beats and 56.5 to 74.1 for downbeats compared to BeatNet+, the current state of the art in online beat tracking.

translated_title: 《Beat This! Live——通过预测未来实现的在线节拍与强拍跟踪》
translated_abstract: 节拍跟踪与强拍跟踪近年来通过深度学习方法取得了多项进展，但大多数方法针对的是离线设置，因而无法应用于实时场景。我们将近期的一个离线节拍跟踪模型 Beat This 改造为在线、低延迟运行的版本，并提出了 Beat This! Live——一个专为实时节拍与强拍跟踪设计的因果变体。我们介绍了为获得适合流式推理的因果系统所需的架构修改，并测量了这些修改对准确率的影响。通过使用时间偏移的标签来训练模型，它能够产生略微领先于当前帧的预测，这不仅降低了延迟，还使峰值提取更加有效。在 GTZAN 数据集上的评估表明，与当前在线节拍跟踪领域最先进的 BeatNet+ 相比，节拍跟踪的 F1 分数从 80.6 提升至 86.7，强拍跟踪的 F1 分数从 56.5 提升至 74.1。
tldr: 该论文提出了 Beat This! Live——一个通过时间偏移标签训练、能够略微超前预测未来帧的因果模型，实现了低延迟的在线节拍与强拍跟踪，并在 GTZAN 数据集上显著超越现有最先进的在线方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Beat This! Live, a causal low-latency model for online beat and downbeat tracking that predicts slightly ahead of the current frame via temporally shifted label training, substantially outperforming the state-of-the-art online method BeatNet+ on the GTZAN dataset.
